svg.title: Javis picks the smallest tool that finishes the job
svg.desc: A chat message goes to the Javis router, which picks one option on a ladder from light to heavy: answer directly, queue a task, create a skill, agent or workflow, set a reminder, or start a loop.
svg.text: Javis picks the smallest tool that finishes the job.

g.text: queued, result lands in this chat
